## Purpose

Describe the problem, the change, and its user-visible effect.

## Scientific impact

State the definitions, units, conventions, supported cases, limitations, and
capability status affected. Write `Not applicable` when there is no scientific
change.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests were added or updated for behavior changes.
- [ ] The focused tests and complete test suite pass.
- [ ] Scientific validation was run or is not applicable.
- [ ] Documentation matches the current CLI and Python behavior.
- [ ] New fixtures and assets include provenance and checksums.
- [ ] Third-party code, data, and assets have compatible license terms and attribution.
- [ ] No confidential data, private paths, credentials, or generated build files are included.

List the exact commands run and summarize the results.
